timing.cold: First measured fixture/call after untimed setup; not an OS or disk-cache cold start.
timing.hot: Five subsequent independent fixtures or repeated calls after one discarded warmup.

netBenefitRule: Report a timing advantage only when the enhanced median is lower and every enhanced sample is below every strong-naive sample. Otherwise report no-net-time-benefit. Never infer a general speedup from a sample mean.
scales: Synthetic ledger sizes exercise the existing JSONL query path. They are workload scales, not capacity promises.
fixedCopy: Report copyMs/copyBytes/runMs from the real fixed-file verifier separately from total consumption time.
nativeBaseline: The strong native checker is ledger-independent and is measured once with the same four-consumption workload; its distribution is compared with every Workbench ledger scale.
modelUsage: No provider is called. Token and monetary usage remain unmeasured and must not be reported as zero.
decisionOnBudget: Record every over-budget sample and stop expansion at the frozen definition. Never raise a budget after measuring.
